notes: Region config for the Conditions at a Glance dashboard. Only regions with enabled=true appear in the selector. Each reading lists sources in order of preference; the server uses the first one with a fresh report and says which one it used. Station choices were checked against live NDBC, CO-OPS, and NWS data on 12 Nov 2026. Wilmington and Nags Head private-preview sources were checked against live NDBC, CO-OPS, and NWS data on 13 Nov 2026. Only regions with brief=true get a Morning Brief (Crystal Coast and Hatteras; Falls Lake is added by brief.py when freshwater is on). Enabling a region does not give it a brief. Carolina Beach / Kure Beach and Corolla / Duck private-preview sources were checked against live NDBC, CO-OPS, and NWS data on 15 Nov 2026.

tide.name: Bogue Inlet
tide.note: NOAA publishes official high and low tide predictions at Bogue Inlet, but not a 6-minute curve or a local water-level gauge. TEC2837 is a subordinate prediction station; its published reference, 8654400 Cape Hatteras Fishing Pier, has no live water-level gauge, so there is no official observed reference. The Swansboro bridge curve and Beaufort observed water level are not used.

regions.notes: Public since 14 Nov 2026. Town of Emerald Isle only, from Bogue Inlet to the east town line. Not Swansboro, Cedar Point or Cape Carteret; alerts are AMZ158 and NCZ195 only (NCZ199 comes in when Swansboro is added). Wind, seas and offshore temperature come from the Onslow Bay Outer buoys, about 32 miles offshore, and are labeled as such. Air temperature is the Bogue Field ASOS, about 5 miles northeast; the offshore buoy is not used for air. Inshore water temperature is unavailable. Tide predictions are official highs and lows at Bogue Inlet, a subordinate station whose reference has no live water-level gauge; there is no 6-minute curve and no local observed water level.

Official high and low predictions; NOAA computes them from reference station 8654400 Cape Hatteras Fishing Pier (type S; height ratios 1.4 high / 1.25 low; time offsets +18 min high / +10 min low). There is no 6-minute curve and no local water-level gauge. The physical station was removed in 1979. Do not draw Wrightsville's curve under these highs and lows.

regions.notes: Private preview, cookie-gated; not in the public region list and not a published Morning Brief. Covers Carolina Beach and Kure Beach from Masonboro Inlet to Federal Point / Cape Fear. Not downtown Wilmington, Southport, or Oak Island. Wind, air and pressure come from MBIN7, 4.3 miles NNE, and are labeled. Seas, swell and nearshore water temperature come from 41110, 12.8 miles NE at Masonboro Inlet, and are labeled; that buoy is also Wilmington's primary wave source. Inshore water temperature is unavailable; Wrightsville pier water is not used as local. Tide predictions are official highs and lows at subordinate station 8658559 Wilmington Beach (reference 8654400 Cape Hatteras Fishing Pier); there is no 6-minute curve and no local observed water level. Observed water level is Wrightsville Beach 8658163, 14.0 miles NNE, and is labeled as such. Alerts are AMZ250 and NCZ108 only.

marine.zoneName: S of Currituck Beach Light NC to Oregon Inlet NC out to 20 NM
marine.zoneNote: AMZ150 is the official ocean zone at Duck Pier. Its northern edge is Currituck Beach Light in Corolla; the same zone is also used for Nags Head, south to Oregon Inlet. Waters north of the light, including the ocean off Corolla toward Carova, are not in AMZ150. An AKQ ocean zone for that stretch was not identified.

regions.notes: Private preview, cookie-gated; not in the public region list and not a published Morning Brief. Centered on Duck Pier until an official Corolla coordinate is published; Corolla has no official wind, tide, or wave station. Wind, air, pressure, tide predictions and observed water level are from 8651370 Duck Pier. Seas, swell and nearshore water temperature are from 44056, 2.2 miles ENE at the Duck FRF, and are labeled. Inshore water temperature is unavailable; Oregon Inlet marina water is not used. Land offices split the two towns: Duck forecast is MHX (grid 85, 128); Corolla land zone is NCZ102 Eastern Currituck (NWS Wakefield / AKQ). Alert zones are AMZ150, NCZ203 Northern Outer Banks (Duck townsite confirmed NCZ203 / Dare County NCC055 by NWS /points at 36.163, -75.75 on 15 Nov 2026), and NCZ102 Eastern Currituck (Corolla confirmed NCZ102 / Currituck County NCC053 by NWS /points at 36.377, -75.830 the same day). Do not add Hatteras or Chesapeake zones.
